items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Al Rose had asked me to bring my horn around her, so I did.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's got an old age pension. Mm-hmm. He's turned 65 since he came back.

You hear him around there, Eddie? I never, I heard him a carnival day. I didn't know it was him until I left the place. He was playing upstairs over, opposite Dixie's, you know? Yeah. And Al Rose had asked me to bring my horn around her, so I did. I thought I'd run into Al, but I never didn't. I come around there, but I didn't see Al.
